hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && printf '
== operating doctrine ==
Read CLAUDE.md, then provenance/observations.md.
A claim is either tagged [src:ID] or it is not written down.
Open questions go in provenance/unknowns.md.
' && { python3 tools/verify_provenance.py 2>&1 | tail -3; } # briefing only: not a gate
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(python3 tools/verify_provenance.py 2>&1); status=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -20; exit $status
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(bash tests/run_all.sh 2>&1); status=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -25; exit $status
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 tools/lint_delegation.py # advisory: always exits 0, never blocks the delegation
